basics.name: Alex Profir
basics.label: Senior Full-Stack Engineer
basics.summary: I build applications from the ground up with a strong emphasis on reliability and product quality. I work closely with stakeholders to turn early ideas into clear requirements, then deliver them with the testing and monitoring that keep the product working once it's live. I am open to remote or hybrid roles.

work.name: Independent Contractor
work.summary: Contracting through my own company. Clients include a faith-based social network, where I am technical lead, and MoreDevs, where I continued work on its cybersecurity platform until Oct 2026.

work.name: MoreDevs
work.summary: Built web, mobile and backend products for clients, working mainly on a cybersecurity platform from 2022.

projects.name: Faith-Based Social Network App
projects.description: iOS and Android app with feeds, groups and video.
highlights: Technical lead for a team of 4–6 engineers, responsible for architecture, planning, code review and mentoring
Delivered features in 2–3 weeks, against an estimated 2 months or more without AI, using a workflow I built that takes a Jira ticket and its Figma design through to an open pull request
Set up CI with linting, type checks, tests and secret scanning, and scripted Fastlane releases to Firebase App Distribution and App Store Connect, so every update is checked and shipped the same way
Set up crash reporting and monitoring with Sentry and Crashlytics, so problems can be found before users report them
Built feeds, groups and video playback with offline caching, and wrote native iOS and Android modules for audio focus, SMS consent and text input

projects.name: Cybersecurity Platform
projects.description: Device security product with a mobile app, web admin UI and cloud backend. Team of 4–6 engineers.
highlights: Built threat detection features, including man-in-the-middle detection on the device
Built notification and device management microservices to start replacing the monolith, and worked with teammates on the auth microservice
Migrated infrastructure from Cloud Functions to Cloud Run, cutting costs by at least 25% according to billing and improving scalability
Built the React Native app, the web admin UI, and two JavaScript SDKs connecting them to backend services
Built third-party integrations using webhooks and Cloud Run tasks for reliable asynchronous processing
Delivered features at least 2x faster with spec-driven, agentic development, as reported by the team lead
